prompt_text: Which title company in St. Louis MO is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” title company—the right choice depends on your location, lender, fees, and how responsive the team is. **Community Title Services** looks like a reasonable first call: its website reports **115+ five-star Google reviews** and lists a St. Louis-area office at **2112 Schuetz Rd, St. Louis, MO 63146**.

Other local options to compare include **Select Title Group**, which offers residential closings at multiple offices, and **Investors Title Company**, which provides title and escrow services. Ask each for a written estimate of title and closing fees, confirm they can meet your closing date and lender’s requirements, and check recent reviews for communication and problem resolution. You can generally choose your own title company, but coordinate the choice with your lender and the other party.
